summary: ALNG ASA provides liquefied natural gas (LNG) shipping and transportation services. The company engages in the ownership, operation, and chartering of LNG carriers, offering transportation solutions for the global energy sector. It serves energy companies, utilities, and industrial customers internationally. The company owns and operates LNG vessels, including the WilForce and WilPride, which are 156,000 cbm TFDE membrane LNG carriers. The company was formerly known as Awilco LNG ASA and changed its name to ALNG ASA in June 2026. ALNG ASA was incorporated in 2011 and is based in Oslo, Norway.
